title: Science Academies Summer Research Fellowship 2027
summary: Two-month summer research project with a scientist or faculty guide from IAS, INSA or NASI at labs and institutes across India.
eligibility: UG and PG students in science, engineering, maths, pharmacy, architecture, BCA/MCA and integrated programmes in specified years (e.g. BSc 2nd yr, BTech 2nd–3rd yr, MSc/MTech 1st yr); 65%+ in core subjects from Class X. PhD students not eligible. Teachers can also apply.

prize.description: Monthly fellowship for living expenses plus round-trip train fare. The 2027 notice does not state the monthly amount.

notes: Needs a 150–250 word write-up and a recommendation from a teacher.
Results and guide concurrence go out March–April 2027; the fellowship runs for two months, preferably in summer.
